seg.seg_note: Four segments in FY2015: RF Communications, Government Communications Systems, Integrated Network Solutions, and Exelis (acquired 29-May-2015; about one month of results). From FY2016 the company reorganised into Communication Systems, Space and Intelligence Systems, Electronic Systems and Critical Networks. Segment orders / funded backlog from the FY2015 10-K (orders in $ billions: RF 1.65, GCS 1.96, INS 1.17; Exelis orders $250m post-closing per the release); unfunded backlog: GCS $2.9bn, INS 777, Exelis $3.2bn. Segment values are the release figures (one decimal); the 10-K prints whole millions.

ngaap.guidance: FY2016 (initial): GAAP net income $5.25 to $5.45 per diluted share; non-GAAP net income (excluding estimated integration and other Exelis acquisition-related charges of $.35) $5.60 to $5.80 per diluted share; revenue $7.67 to $7.83 billion.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP income from continuing operations / EPS excludes costs related to the Exelis acquisition (transaction, financing, integration and other costs; $281.5m pre-tax) and charges for restructuring and other items ($31.7m); total pre-tax 313.2, tax (95.9), after-tax 217.3 = $2.03 per share (only the after-tax total is given per share). The Exelis costs are tagged "op" but include financing costs in non-operating income (the FY2015 non-operating loss of 108 includes a 118 loss on prepayment of long-term debt; the 10-K says the $313m was "primarily recorded in unallocated corporate expense and non-operating income (loss)"). Acquired-intangible amortization is NOT excluded. Free cash flow = operating cash flow less net capital expenditures; Exelis alone: operating cash flow 82.8, capex (4.0), FCF 78.8. Fourth-quarter non-GAAP segment operating income: RF 159.4, INS 15.8.

notes: is.lines_raw = 10-K statement of income (first column) followed by the earnings-release condensed statement lines (prefixed "[Q4 release ...]"), which add dividends per share and weighted average shares; mapped keys use the 10-K. is.op_income is computed (sales - cogs - sga - other operating lines); the statement of income prints no operating income line. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). The release prints one decimal (revenue 5,083.2, cost of sales 3,362.0, ESA 1,008.6, non-operating (108.1), interest expense 129.9, pre-tax 476.9, taxes 142.8, income from continuing operations 334.1); the 10-K prints whole millions and is used for the mapped keys. Total company orders for the year are not published (release: fourth-quarter orders $1.53 billion). The FY2016 documents reclassified $46m of FY2015 impairments out of cost of sales (14) and ESA (32) into "Impairment of goodwill and other assets". Self-checks: all pass.
